2026-06-05: <FullBleedShell> primitive (src/components/full-bleed-shell.tsx) added. Sets data-fullbleed='' on the closest <main> via useLayoutEffect. globals.css strips the inner padded div's spacing while the attribute is present (main[data-fullbleed] > .layout-shell-content { padding: 0; max-width: none; height: 100% }). Used by /worklog. RULE: never use viewport-relative height (100vh, calc(100vh-Xrem)) inside a page rendered by LayoutShell — the shell already gives a fully-sized scroll container; opt into <FullBleedShell> when you need to fill it.

2026-06-05: ADR-0013 — LayoutShell conditionally mounts <WorklogDndProvider> when pathname.startsWith('/worklog') so the DndContext spans both the override sidebar and the page. Pattern: route-specific providers belong in LayoutShell, not the page. Documented in .github/ui/global.md 'Section Nav Override Pattern'.

2026-06-05: Sidebar (src/components/sidebar.tsx) now has a route-override branch: when pathname.startsWith('/worklog') AND not collapsed, renders <WorklogNavSidebar onCollapse={toggle} /> instead of <NavLinks>. Collapsed mode always falls back to default top-level nav (escape hatch). New override routes follow the same pattern — do NOT fork all of NavLinks; sibling component.
